patch_description:
This redesign separates the solution into two encoder/decoder engines behind a common interactive controller.

- For zero-noise cases, it uses a compact small-graph isomorphism codec. Graphs are selected greedily by permutation-invariant edit distance, then decoded through canonical graph masks.
- For noisy cases, it uses a large 100-vertex invariant codec. Each codeword has a distinct edge count and a deterministic heterogeneous degree profile. Decoding combines the noise-corrected edge-count likelihood with a lower-weight sorted-degree signature likelihood.
- The architecture removes shared mutable global graph state, encapsulates graph construction/decoding into classes, and makes the strategy selection and query loop straightforward.
